label: South Coast Group 7
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

artwork.format: webp (lossy, with alpha) -> png via dwebp

ground_removed.colour: none: the ground was already clear

provenance: Unit emblem of South Coast Group 7 (PCR-CA-006), digital artwork sent by the owner, 2026-11-18, as the unit's official digital emblem. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (lossy, with alpha), 1023 x 996 px, 8-bit RGBA after decoding; the file came with its ground already clear and a hard edge with no semi-transparent pixel at all, so no pixel was changed; the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (1023 x 996 px to 1013 x 972 px); every pixel inside the emblem's outline is untouched; no resampling, no redrawing, no tracing, no other colour change. Charter: PCR-CA-006 is the unit the owner named for this emblem, which reads SOUTH COAST GROUP SEVEN; the builder's unit list names it SOUTH COAST GROUP 7. A group headquarters, so its echelon is group.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the trim to the emblem's box.
